name: Argoverse 2 LiDAR Dataset
description: Large-scale self-supervised LiDAR dataset containing 20,000 unannotated 10-second sequences (~2 million point cloud scans) captured with dual 32-beam sensors across six US cities for unsupervised representation learning and scene flow.

size.notes: Exact aggregate payload size is not formally published in the documentation; distributed via s5cmd/S3 as 20,000 raw 10-second LiDAR sequences across 6 US cities.

citation.paper_title: Argoverse 2: Next Generation Datasets for Self-Driving Perception and Forecasting

provenance.collection_method: Recorded with vehicle roof-mounted dual 32-beam rotating LiDARs operating at 10 Hz across six metropolitan regions in the United States.
provenance.curation_notes: Officially separate component of the Argoverse 2 suite. Contains 20,000 raw 10-second unannotated sequences (~2 million total LiDAR sweeps) explicitly curated for self-supervised pretraining, point cloud completion, and unconstrained scene flow estimation.
